messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, socho tumhare ghar mein ek chhota sa khet hai aur paas mein 500 rupaye hain. Agar bina soche saara paisa mithaai par kharch kar doge to khet mein beej kaise boyenge?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, tab to khet khali reh jayega aur aage khana bhi nahi milega! Pehle beej aur khad khareedna padega.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Isi tarah jab 1947 mein hamara desh azad hua, tab desh ke paas khazane mein paisa bohot kam tha aur log bohot gareeb the. Isliye sarkar ne tay kiya ki hum pehle zaroori cheezon ka hisab lagayenge, jise 'Economic Planning' (Aarthik Yojna) kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab sarkar ne socha ki pehle kahan kharch karne se desh ka fayda hoga!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Azadi se pehle 1934 mein ek bohot bade engineer aur vidwan the — Sir M. Visvesvaraya. Unhone ek mashhoor kitab likhi jiska naam tha 'Planned Economy for India'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, unhone us kitab mein kya bataya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unhone likha ki agar Bharat ko gareebi se nikalna hai, to agle 10 saal ke liye ek niyamit plan banana padega aur karkhane (industries) lagane honge. Unhi ke janamdin (15 September) par har saal 'Engineers' Day' manaya jata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! To unhone sabse pehle 10 saal ke plan ki baat ki thi.

quiz_payload.question: 1934 mein 'Planned Economy for India' naamak mashhoor kitab kisne likhi thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Sir M. Visvesvaraya ne 1934 mein 'Planned Economy for India' likhi thi, jisme unhone 10-varshiya planning ka prastav diya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Usi saal 1934 mein vyapariyon ke sabse bade sangathan FICCI (Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry) ne bhi kaha ki desh ko aage badhane ke liye ek National Planning Commission banna chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, FICCI vyapariyon ka group tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Unka kehna tha ki bina sarkar ki planning ke desh mein bade karkhane lagana mushkil hoga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1938 mein Congress ka Haripura session hua jiske President the Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose. Unhone kaha ki azadi ke baad desh kaise chalega, iske liye abhi se ek committee banao.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, us committee ka naam kya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Uska naam rakha gaya 'National Planning Committee' (NPC - Rashtriya Yojna Samiti). Netaji ne iska Chairman banaya Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru ko.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Netaji ne committee banayi aur Nehru ji ko uska head banaya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nehru ji ne is committee mein alag-alag arthshastriyon (economists), scientists (jaise Meghnad Saha) aur udyogpatiyon ko bulaya. Unhone kheti, udyog, transport aur khazane par 29 alag-alag reports taiyar karwayin.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya unki report turant lagu ho gayi thi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi, kyunki 1939 mein Second World War shuru ho gaya aur hamare netaon ko jail mein daal diya gaya. Lekin is committee ne azadi ke baad ki planning ki neev rakh di thi.

quiz_payload.question: 1938 mein Congress President Subhash Chandra Bose ki pehal par bani 'National Planning Committee' ke Chairman kaun the?
quiz_payload.explanation: 1938 mein bani National Planning Committee ke Chairman Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru the.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1944 mein Mumbai ke 8 bade udyogpati (jaise JRD Tata, GD Birla, Purushottamdas Thakurdas, Kasturbhai Lalbhai, John Mathai) ek sath baithe. Unhone milkar ek document nikala jise 'Bombay Plan' kaha jata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, unka mukhya maqsad kya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unhone kaha ki agle 15 saal mein desh ki kheti ki aamdani 2 guna aur factory ki aamdani 5 guna karni hai. Unka sabse bada sujhav tha ki sarkar ko hi shuruaat mein sadak, bijli aur coal jaise bhaari udyogon mein paisa lagana hoga.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab bade udyogpati bhi chahte the ki pehle sarkar aage aaye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Usi saal 1944 mein ek aur plan aaya jiska naam tha 'Gandhian Plan'. Ise Shriman Narayan Agarwal (SN Agarwal) ne banaya tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, isme Gandhi ji ke vichar the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Isme kaha gaya ki shehar ki badi factories ke bajaye gaon ki kheti, charkha, hathkargha (handloom) aur kutir udyog (cottage industries) par zor do, taaki gaon ka har kisan aatmanirbhar bane.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bombay Plan factory ke liye tha aur Gandhian Plan gaon ke liye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1945 mein ek mahan communist neta M.N. Roy (Manabendra Nath Roy) ne banaya 'People's Plan' (Janata Ki Yojna).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, unhone kiske baare mein socha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unhone kaha ki 10 saal mein kisanon aur majdooron ko roti, kapda, makan, swasthya aur padhai ki basic suvidha milni chahiye aur zameen ka sara haq kisanon ko milna chahiye.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: January 1950 mein hamare Bihar ke mahan swatantrata senani Loknayak Jaiprakash Narayan (JP) ne prastut kiya 'Sarvodaya Plan'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, JP Narayan ji ne isme kya khas baat boli thi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unhone Mahatma Gandhi aur Vinoba Bhave ke vicharon ko milakar kaha ki zameen garibon mein baanti jaye, gaon mein Panchayati Raj ho aur bina videshi madad ke desh aage badhe. BPSC mein Sarvodaya Plan ka saal aur JP ka naam bar-bar pucha jata hai!

quiz_payload.question:
Sahi jodi milayein:
1. Gandhian Plan (1944) — (a) M.N. Roy
2. People's Plan (1945) — (b) Shriman Narayan Agarwal
3. Sarvodaya Plan (1950) — (c) Jaiprakash Narayan

Sahi vikalp chunein:
quiz_payload.explanation: Gandhian Plan = S.N. Agarwal; People's Plan = M.N. Roy; Sarvodaya Plan = Jaiprakash Narayan.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1946 mein aazadi se thoda pehle ek Advisory Planning Board banaya gaya tha jiske head the K.C. Neogy.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Neogy ji ne kya sifarish ki thi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unhone sifarish ki thi ki desh mein ek aisi permanent sanstha honi chahiye jo poore desh ke resources ka pata lagaye aur vikas ka plan banaye. Unhi ki sifarish par aage chalkar Planning Commission bana.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 15 March 1950 ko Pradhan Mantri Jawaharlal Nehru ki Cabinet ne ek aadesh pass karke 'Planning Commission' (Yojana Aayog) ka gathan kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, is date ko to red pen se mark karna padega!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! 15 March 1950 ki date BPSC aur SSC dono ka pakka sawaal hai. Iska office New Delhi ke 'Yojana Bhawan' mein banaya gaya tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kitabon mein likha hota hai ki Planning Commission 'Extra-Constitutional' aur 'Non-Statutory' body thi. Iska kya matlab hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Aasan bhasha mein samjho:
1. Non-Constitutional (Gair-Samvidhanik): Samvidhan ke kisi Article mein iska zikr nahi tha (jaise Election Commission Article 324 mein hai par ye kisi article mein nahi tha).
2. Non-Statutory: Parliament ne koi kanoon pass karke ise nahi banaya, balki Cabinet ke ek aadesh (Executive Resolution) se ye bana.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab sarkar ne bas aadesh nikal kar ise banaya tha!

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission of India ka samvidhanik darja (status) kya tha?

options.text: Parliament Act dwara sthapit Statutory Sanstha
Cabinet ke aadesh se bani Extra-Constitutional aur Non-Statutory body

quiz_payload.explanation: Planning Commission ek Extra-Constitutional aur Non-Statutory body thi, jise Union Cabinet ke resolution se banaya gaya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Planning Commission ki structure aisi thi:
• Chairman: Desh ke Prime Minister (Ex-officio, matlab jo bhi PM banega wo automatically Chairman ban jayega).
• Deputy Chairman: PM dwara chuna gaya vyakti (isko Cabinet Minister ka darja aur suvidha milti thi).
• Members: Finance Minister, Defence Minister aur alag-alag kshetron ke technical experts.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, to sara roz ka kaam kaun dekhta tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Deputy Chairman hi sara full-time kaam sambhalte the.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exams ke liye ye do naam hamesha yaad rakhna:
• Pehle Deputy Chairman: Gulzarilal Nanda (1950)
• Aakhiri Deputy Chairman: Montek Singh Ahluwalia (2004 se 2014 tak).
Iske alawa Dr. Manmohan Singh aur Pranab Mukherjee bhi pehle Deputy Chairman reh chuke the.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Gulzarilal Nanda pehle aur Montek Singh Ahluwalia aakhiri the!

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission of India ke AAKHIRI (Last) Deputy Chairman kaun the?
quiz_payload.explanation: Montek Singh Ahluwalia 2004 se 2014 tak Planning Commission ke aakhiri Deputy Chairman the. Pehle Gulzarilal Nanda the.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Planning Commission to Delhi mein baith kar plan bana leti thi, lekin sabhi rajyon ke Chief Ministers ko sath lene ke liye 6 August 1952 ko banayi gayi NDC (National Development Council / Rashtriya Vikas Parishad).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, NDC mein kaun-kaun log hote the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Prime Minister (Chairman), Sabhi Union Cabinet Ministers, Sabhi Rajyon ke Mukhyamantri (CMs), UTs ke Administrators aur Planning Commission ke members.

navigation.button_text: NDC Ko 'Super Cabinet' Kyun Kaha Gaya? ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Planning Commission jo bhi 5-saal ka plan taiyar karti thi, usko final approval (manjoori) NDC hi deti thi. Prasiddh vidwan K. Santhanam ne NDC ko 'Super Cabinet' kaha tha kyunki isme PM aur sabhi CMs baithkar desh ke vikas ka aakhiri faisla karte the.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab jab tak NDC paas nahi karegi, tab tak plan lagu nahi ho sakta tha!

quiz_payload.question: National Development Council (NDC / Rashtriya Vikas Parishad) ki sthapna kab hui thi aur iska mukhya karya kya tha?

options.text: 15 March 1950 — Supreme Court ke rules banana
6 August 1952 — Five-Year Plans ko antim roop se approve karna

quiz_payload.explanation: NDC 6 August 1952 ko bani thi aur iska mukhya karya Five-Year Plans ka mulyankan aur antim anumodan (approval) dena tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: BPSC TRE aur BPSC Prelims ka favorite sawal: Samvidhan ki 7th Schedule mein 3 lists hain (Union, State, Concurrent). 'Economic and Social Planning' (Aarthik aur Samajik Yojna) CONCURRENT LIST (Samvarti Soochi) ke Item Number 20 par darj hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Concurrent List matlab Centre aur Bihar sarkar dono ispar kanoon aur yojnayein bana sakte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi Raju! Isliye Centre level par Planning Commission tha aur Bihar level par State Planning Board!

quiz_payload.question: Bhartiya Samvidhan ki 7th Schedule mein 'Aarthik aur Samajik Yojna' (Economic and Social Planning) kis soochi ka vishay hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Planning Samvarti Soochi (Concurrent List) ke Entry 20 ka hissa hai, jisme Parliament aur State Legislature dono ko adhikar hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, humne 5-5 saal ka hi plan kyun chuna? 3 saal ya 7 saal ka kyun nahi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Kyunki 1928 mein Soviet Union (USSR/Russia) ke neta Joseph Stalin ne 'Gosplan' (5-year planning system) shuru kiya tha, jisse Russia ne bohot tezi se tarakki ki. Jawaharlal Nehru socialist vicharon se prabhavit the, isliye unhone wahi model Bharat mein apnaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! To Five-Year Plan ka concept Russia se aaya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
First Five-Year Plan (1 April 1951 se 31 March 1956 tak chala):
• Model: Harrod-Domar Growth Model (do arthshastriyon Roy Harrod aur Evsey Domar ke model par based tha).
• Mukhya Focus: Kheti (Agriculture), Sinchai (Irrigation), Bijli aur Price Stability.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Harrod-Domar model kya kehta tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Wo kehta tha ki desh mein jitni zyada bachat (saving) aur investment hogi, desh utni hi tezi se aage badhega.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1st Plan ke growth numbers note karo:
• Target Growth Rate: 2.1%
• Actual Growth Rate Hasil Hui: 3.6%!
Matlab plan target se bohot zyada safal raha. Monsoon accha hua aur anaj ka utpadan 52 million tonnes se badhkar 66 million tonnes ho gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Target tha 2.1% aur mila 3.6%, ye to bohot badiya result tha!

navigation.button_text: 1st Plan Ke Dam Aur River Projects ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Khet mein paani pahunchane ke liye 1st Plan mein 3 vishalkay nadi ghati pariyojnayein (River Valley Projects) shuru hui:
1. Bhakra-Nangal Baandh (Sutlej Nadi par)
2. Hirakud Baandh (Mahanadi par Odisha mein — Bharat ka sabse lamba baandh)
3. Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC - Damodar Nadi par, America ke TVA model par).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nehru ji ne inhi baandhon ko 'Modern India Ke Mandir' kaha tha na Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan bilkul sahi! Unhone kaha tha ki ye baandh hi desh ki gareebi door karenge.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1st Plan ke do historical programmes BPSC ke liye rat lo:
1. 2 October 1952: Community Development Programme (CDP - Samudayik Vikas Karyakram) shuru hua America ke sahyog se.
2. 1953: National Extension Service (Rashtriya Prasar Seva) shuru hui.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, CDP mein gaon ke logon ko raste aur safai ke liye milkar kaam karna tha na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, gaon ke logo ki bhagidari se vikas karna tha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1st Plan ke dauran aur kya-kya bana:
• 1951: Pehla IIT (IIT Kharagpur) shuru hua (plan khatam hone tak 5 IITs ki neev pad gayi thi).
• 1953: UGC (University Grants Commission) bana.
• 1 July 1955: Gorewala Committee ki sifarish par Imperial Bank of India ka nationalisation karke SBI (State Bank of India) banaya gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: SBI Bank bhi 1st Plan ke time hi bana tha!

quiz_payload.question:
Pehli Panchvarshiya Yojana (1951-56) ke sandarbh mein kaun sa kathan SAHI hai?
1. Ye Harrod-Domar Model par aadharit thi.
2. Isme actual growth rate (3.6%) target (2.1%) se zyada rahi.
3. 2 October 1952 ko Community Development Programme shuru hua.
quiz_payload.explanation: Teeno kathan bilkul sahi hain. First Plan Harrod-Domar model par thi, 3.6% growth hasil hui aur 1952 mein CDP shuru hua.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Second Five-Year Plan (1 April 1956 se 31 March 1961 tak chala):
• Model: Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis 4-Sector Model (Capital Goods Strategy).
• Mukhya Focus: Rapid Industrialisation & Heavy Industries (Bhaari Udyog aur Steel Plants).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, P.C. Mahalanobis kaun the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Wo Bharat ke mahan sankhyiki vidwan (statistician) the jinhone Kolkata mein Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) banaya tha. Unke janamdin (29 June) ko hum 'National Statistics Day' manate hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1955 mein Madras ke paas Avadi mein Congress ka session hua (President the U.N. Dhebar). Wahan sankalp liya gaya ki Bharat mein 'Socialistic Pattern of Society' (Samajvadi Dhancha) banaya jayega.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, iska aasan matlab kya hua?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Iska matlab tha ki desh ki saari badi factory, khadaan aur train sarkar chalayegi taaki ameer-gareeb ki khaai kam ho aur fayda sabhi janta ko mile.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Second Plan ke dauran sarkar ne 30 April 1956 ko 'Industrial Policy Resolution 1956' (IPR 1956) nikala. Isko Bharat ka 'Economic Constitution' (Aarthik Samvidhan) kaha jata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, isme udyogon ko kaise baanta gaya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Udyogon ko 3 schedules mein baanta gaya:
• Schedule A (17 Udyog): Sirf sarkar chalayegi (jaise Railway, Parmanu, Hathiyar, Steel)
• Schedule B (12 Udyog): Sarkar aur Private dono chalayenge
• Schedule C: Baaki bache udyog private ke liye chhod diye gaye.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Second Plan mein 3 bade steel plants videshi sahyog se lagaye gaye:
1. Bhilai Steel Plant: Durg (Chhattisgarh) mein, Soviet Union (USSR/Russia) ki madad se.
2. Rourkela Steel Plant: Sundargarh (Odisha) mein, West Germany (Krupp & Demag company) ki madad se.
3. Durgapur Steel Plant: Bardhaman (West Bengal) mein, United Kingdom (Britain) ki madad se.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bhilai = Russia, Rourkela = Germany, Durgapur = Britain!

navigation.button_text: 2nd Plan Ke Growth Numbers Aur Panchayati Raj ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Second Plan ke growth numbers aur ahem events:
• Target Growth Rate: 4.5% | Actual Growth Rate: 4.27% (Theek-thak safal raha).
• 1956: KVIC (Khadi and Village Industries Commission) bana.
• 2 October 1959: Rajasthan ke Nagaur mein pehli baar Panchayati Raj shuru hua (Balwant Rai Mehta Committee ki sifarish par).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Panchayati Raj bhi 2nd plan ke dauran hi shuru hua tha!

quiz_payload.question: Doosri Panchvarshiya Yojana (1956-61) ke sandarbh mein kaun sa joda GALAT hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Option C galat hai kyunki Rourkela Steel Plant (Odisha) West Germany ke sahyog se lagaya gaya tha, USA se nahi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Third Five-Year Plan (1 April 1961 se 31 March 1966 tak chala):
• Model: John Sandy aur Sukhamoy Chakravarty Model (Ise D.R. Gadgil ki yojana par aadharit hone ke karan 'Gadgil Yojana' bhi kehte hain).
• Mukhya Goal: Self-reliant aur Self-generating Economy (Kheti aur Bhaari Udyog dono ko aatmanirbhar banana).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, 1st plan mein kheti tha, 2nd mein factory, aur 3rd mein dono ko sath lekar chalna tha!

navigation.button_text: 3rd Plan Kyun Fail Hua? (3 Badi Aafatein) ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Teesri yojana Bharat ke itihas ki sabse buri tarah fail hone wali yojana thi:
• Target Growth: 5.6% | Actual Growth: Sirf 2.84%!
Fail hone ke 3 bade karan the:
1. 1962: Sino-Indian War (China se yuddh)
2. 1965: Indo-Pak War (Pakistan se yuddh)
3. 1965-66: Desh mein 100 saal ka sabse bhayanak sookha (Severe Drought).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Do yuddh aur sookha ek sath pad gaya, isliye sara paisa khatam ho gaya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Teesre plan mein bani zaroori sansthayein note karo:
• 1964: Bokaro Steel Plant (tab Bihar, ab Jharkhand mein) Soviet Union (USSR) ke sahyog se lagaya gaya.
• 1964: IDBI (Industrial Development Bank of India) aur UTI (Unit Trust of India) bane.
• 1965: Food Corporation of India (FCI) aur Agricultural Prices Commission (ab CACP) bane taaki kisanon ko MSP (Minimum Support Price) mil sake.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bokaro 3rd plan mein bana aur baaki 3 steel plants 2nd plan mein!

quiz_payload.question: Bokaro Steel Plant (1964) aur Food Corporation of India (FCI - 1965) kis Panchvarshiya Yojana ke dauran sthapit hue the?
quiz_payload.explanation: Bokaro Steel Plant aur FCI dono Third Five-Year Plan (1961-66) ke dauran sthapit kiye gaye the.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1966 mein teesra plan khatam hua par yuddh aur sookhe ke karan desh mein anaj aur paise ka bhayanak sankat tha. Isliye sarkar ne 1966 se 1969 tak teen saal ke liye 5-year plans ko rok diya. Is 3 saal ke daur ko 'Plan Holiday' (Yojana Avkash) kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, to in teen saal mein desh kaise chala?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Teen Annual Plans (1-1 saal ke plan) banakar chalaye gaye: 1966-67, 1967-68 aur 1968-69.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Plan Holiday ke dauran 6 June 1966 ko Pradhan Mantri Indira Gandhi ki sarkar ne Bhartiya Rupee ka 36.5% Devaluation (avmulyan) kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Devaluation ka kya matlab hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Iska matlab sarkar ne videshi currency (dollar) ke mukable apne rupaye ki value kam kar di, taaki hamara saman videshon mein sasta ho jaye aur export badhe. Ye Bharat ke itihas ka doosra devaluation tha (pehla 1949 mein hua tha).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Plan Holiday ke dauran hi Bharat ke kheti itihas ka sabse bada badlav aaya — Green Revolution (Harit Kranti):
• Bharat mein Janak: Dr. M.S. Swaminathan
• Vishwa mein Janak: Dr. Norman Borlaug (Nobel Puraskar vijeta)
• Strategy: HYV Seeds (High Yielding Variety — Mexican dwarf gehun ke beej), chemical khad aur tubewell sinchai ka package apnaaya gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isse gehun ki paidawar achanak bohot tezi se badh gayi!

quiz_payload.question: Bharat mein 'Plan Holiday' (Yojana Avkash) kis samayavadhi ke dauran raha aur isme kaun si ahem ghatna hui?

options.text: 1966–1969 — Harit Kranti ki shuruaat aur 3 Annual Plans

quiz_payload.explanation: Plan Holiday 1966 se 1969 tak 3 varsho ke liye raha, jisme 3 Annual Plans lagaye gaye aur Harit Kranti shuru hui.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Fourth Five-Year Plan (1 April 1969 se 31 March 1974 tak chala):
• Model: Ashok Rudra aur A.S. Manne ka Consistency Model (Gadgil Mukherjee Formula par aadharit).
• Mukhya Objective: 'Growth with Stability' (Sthirta ke sath vikas) aur 'Progressive Achievement of Self-Reliance' (Aatmanirbharta ki disha mein aage badhna).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, is time PM Indira Gandhi thi na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Indira Gandhi ji ke netritva mein ye plan bana tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
BPSC aur UPSC ka standard concept: Pehle Centre apni marzi se rajyon ko paisa deta tha. 1969 mein D.R. Gadgil ne ek pakka formula banaya taaki rajyon ko bina bhedbhav ke Kendriya Sahayata (Central Assistance) mile.
Formula ka aadhar:
• Population (60%)
• Per Capita Income (20%)
• Tax Effort (10%)
• Special Problems (10%).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab jis rajya ki aabadi zyada aur aamdani kam hogi, usko zyada madad milegi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Fourth Plan ki sabse badi aarthik ghatna: 19 July 1969 ko Indira Gandhi sarkar ne ek aadesh nikal kar desh ke 14 bade private commercial banks ko sarkari (Nationalise) kar diya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kaun se banko ko sarkari kiya gaya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jin banko ke paas 50 Crore rupaye ya usse zyada ka deposit tha (jaise PNB, Central Bank of India, Bank of India, Canara Bank aadi). Taaki gaon ke chote kisanon ko bhi aasan loan mil sake.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Fourth Plan ke 3 aur bade historical events note karo:
1. 1971: Indo-Pak War aur Bangladesh ka janm (Karon sharnarthi Bharat aaye, jisse budget par asar pada).
2. 1973: DPAP (Drought Prone Area Programme / Sookha Prabhavit Kshetra Karyakram) shuru hua.
3. 18 May 1974: Pokhran mein Bharat ne apna pehla Underground Parmanu Parikshan kiya jiska code naam tha 'Operation Smiling Buddha'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ek hi plan mein 14 bank sarkari, Bangladesh aazad aur pehla parmanu test!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Fourth Plan ke growth numbers:
• Target Growth Rate: 5.7%
• Actual Growth Rate: Sirf 3.3%!
Karan: 1971 war ka kharcha, Bangladesh sharnarthiyon ka bojh, 1973 ka international crude oil crisis (petrol ke daam achanak 4 guna badh gaye the) aur sookha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isliye target 5.7% tha par mila sirf 3.3%.

quiz_payload.question: 14 Commercial Banks ka Rashtriyakaran (1969) aur Pokhran-1 Parmanu Parikshan (1974) kis Five-Year Plan ke dauran hue?
quiz_payload.explanation: Dono ahem ghatnayein Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-74) ke dauran PM Indira Gandhi ke karyakal mein hui thi.

Mahalanobis Model | Heavy Industry | Target: 4.5%, Actual: 4.27% | Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur, IPR 1956
Chakravarty/Gadgil | Self-reliance | Target: 5.6%, Actual: 2.84% (Fail) | Bokaro (1964), FCI (1965), War/Drought
3 Annual Plans | Green Revolution (1966-67) | Rupee Devaluation (June 1966)
Gadgil Formula | Growth with Stability | Target: 5.7%, Actual: 3.3% | 14 Banks Nat. (1969), Pokhran-1 (1974)

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Indian Planning history:
1. National Planning Committee was set up in 1938 under the chairmanship of Jawaharlal Nehru.
2. The Planning Commission was established under Article 280 of the Constitution.
3. The First Five-Year Plan achieved a higher growth rate than its targeted growth rate.

Which of the statements given above are CORRECT?
quiz_payload.explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is WRONG (Article 280 governs the Finance Commission; Planning Commission was an extra-constitutional body).

quiz_payload.question:
Which of the following pairs is/are CORRECTLY matched?
1. Sarvodaya Plan (1950) — Jaiprakash Narayan
2. Second Five-Year Plan — P.C. Mahalanobis Model
3. Bokaro Steel Plant — Fourth Five-Year Plan
4. National Development Council (NDC) — Established on 6 August 1952
quiz_payload.explanation: 1, 2, and 4 are correct. Pair 3 is INCORRECT because Bokaro Steel Plant was established in 1964 during the Third Five-Year Plan, not the Fourth.

quiz_payload.question:
Assertion (A): The government declared a 'Plan Holiday' from 1966 to 1969 instead of launching the Fourth Plan immediately.

Reason (R): Severe resources crisis occurred due to two consecutive wars (1962 and 1965) and a severe drought in 1965-66.

Choose the correct option:

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

quiz_payload.explanation: Both statements are TRUE and R explains A perfectly. Yuddh aur sookhe ke karan resources khatam ho gaye the isliye 3 saal Plan Holiday lena pada.

(a) Community Development Programme — (1) 4th Plan
(b) Bhilai & Rourkela Steel Plants — (2) 1st Plan
(c) Green Revolution Launch — (3) 2nd Plan
(d) 14 Commercial Banks Nationalisation — (4) Plan Holiday

Choose the correct code:
quiz_payload.explanation: CDP = 1st Plan (1952); Steel Plants = 2nd Plan (1956-61); Green Revolution = Plan Holiday (1966-69); 14 Banks = 4th Plan (1969).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab dekho! Humne 1934 se lekar 1974 (4th Plan ke aakhiri din) tak ka poora itihas, ek-ek date, target growth, steel plant aur scheme poori depth mein padh li.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, sach mein! Pehle mujhe sab dates mix ho jaati thi, par ab Visvesvaraya se lekar 1st, 2nd, 3rd Plan, Plan Holiday aur 4th Plan ke 14 banko tak sab sequence mein clear ho gaya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut khoob Raju! Ab Part 2 (Cards 61 se 120) mein hum 5th Plan (Garibi Hatao) se lekar 12th Plan (2017) tak ko isi tarah poore detail mein padhenge!

intro_payload.title: 📊 5th Plan Se 12th Plan Tak Ka Safar (Part 2)
intro_payload.subtitle: 1974 Se Lekar 2017 Tak Ki Poori Detail Kahani

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab aao Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974–1979) par. Ise Planning Commission ke member D.D. Dhar ne design kiya tha, isliye ise 'D.D. Dhar Model' kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, is plan ka sabse mukhya maqsad kya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Do sabse bade goals the:
1. 'Garibi Hatao' (Poverty Eradication)
2. 'Atmanirbharta' (Self-Reliance).
BPSC mein pucha jata hai ki 'Garibi Hatao' kis plan ka official objective tha — to answer Fifth Plan hi hoga!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Fifth Plan ke pehle hi saal (1974) mein sarkar ne shuru kiya 'Minimum Needs Programme' (MNP / Nyunatam Aavashyakta Karyakram).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, iska kya matlab hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Matlab desh ke har garib nagrik ko zinda rehne ke liye basic cheezein — peene ka saaf paani, primary school, gaon mein sadak, bijli aur dawakhana (health centre) zaroor milna chahiye.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1975 mein do ahem ghatnayein hui:
1. 20-Point Programme (20 Sutriya Karyakram) shuru hua garibi door karne ke liye.
2. 2 October 1975 ko M. Narasimham Committee ki sifarish par 'Regional Rural Banks' (RRB / Kshetriya Gramin Bank) shuru hue.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Gramin Bank to hamare block mein bhi hai jahan kisan account kholte hain!

navigation.button_text: 5th Plan 1 Saal Pehle Khatam Kyun Hua? ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Fifth Plan ko 1974 se 1979 tak chalna tha. Lekin 1977 mein Emergency ke baad chunav hue aur Morarji Desai ke netritva mein Janata Party ki sarkar ban gayi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nayi sarkar ne aakar kya kiya Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unhone Congress ka banaya hua 5th Plan 1978 mein hi (1 saal pehle) band kar diya! Isliye ye plan sirf 4 saal (1974–1978) hi chala.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Fifth Plan ke growth numbers note karo:
• Target Growth Rate: 4.4%
• Actual Growth Rate: 4.83%!
Beshak ye 1 saal pehle band hua, par kheti acchi hone ke karan isne apna growth target poora kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Target tha 4.4% aur mila 4.83%!

quiz_payload.question: Kaun si Panchvarshiya Yojana nirdharit samay se ek varsh pehle (1978 mein) hi samapt kar di gayi thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Fifth Five-Year Plan ko Janata Party sarkar ne 1978 mein 1 saal pehle hi terminate kar diya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Morarji Desai sarkar ne 1978 mein 'Rolling Plan' shuru kiya. Ye concept Swedish arthshastri Gunnar Myrdal ne apni mashhoor kitab 'Asian Drama' mein diya tha. Bharat mein ise Planning Commission ke Vice-Chairman D.T. Lakdawala ne lagu kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Rolling Plan mein kaam kaise hota tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Isme 5 saal ka koi pakka thappa nahi lagta tha. Har saal budget check hota tha aur agle saal ka plan pichhle saal ke hisab se roll (aage badha) diya jata tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: January 1980 mein Janata Party ki sarkar gir gayi aur Indira Gandhi dobara Pradhan Mantri bani. Unhone aate hi Rolling Plan ko kudedan mein daal diya aur naya 6th Plan shuru kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To Rolling Plan sirf do saal (1978 se 1980) hi chala!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, is 2 saal ke gap ko hum Rolling Plan period kehte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Bharat mein 'Rolling Plan' (1978-80) kis arthshastri ki pustak 'Asian Drama' ke concept par aadharit tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: Rolling Plan Gunnar Myrdal ke concept par aadharit tha aur D.T. Lakdawala dwara formulate kiya gaya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Sixth Five-Year Plan (1 April 1980 se 31 March 1985 tak chala):
• Model: Input-Output Model par aadharit tha.
• Mukhya Focus: Garibi par seedha hamla (Direct Attack on Poverty), Rozgar badhana aur gaon ka aarthik vikas.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, is plan mein kisanon ke liye kya khas hua?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: BPSC ka super-hit question: B. Sivaraman Committee ki sifarish par 12 July 1982 ko NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) ki sthapna hui!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, NABARD aam logo ko seedhe loan deta hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju! NABARD ek 'Apex Bank' hai. Ye gaon ke gramin bankon aur cooperative bankon ko paisa deta hai, taaki wo kisanon ko saste byaj par tractor aur beej ke liye loan dein.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Sixth Plan ke do aur bade financial events:
1. 15 April 1980: 6 aur private commercial bankon ko sarkari (Nationalise) kiya gaya (jinme 200 Crore se zyada deposit tha).
2. 1982: EXIM Bank (Export-Import Bank of India) banaya gaya videshi vyapar ko badhane ke liye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 4th plan mein 14 bank sarkari hue the aur 6th plan mein 6 aur bank!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Sixth Plan mein gaon ke garibon ke liye kai schemes poore desh mein failayi gayin:
• IRDP (Integrated Rural Development Programme): Garibon ko gay, bhains aur silai machine khareedne ke liye subsidy.
• TRYSEM: Gaon ke yuvaon ko self-employment ke liye training.
• NREP (National Rural Employment Programme): Majdoori kaam.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Gaon ke garibon ko khud ka kaam shuru karne ke liye madad milne lagi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Sixth Plan ke results bohot shandar rahe:
• Target Growth Rate: 5.2%
• Actual Growth Rate: 5.7%!
Is plan ne Bharat ko 'Hindu Rate of Growth' (jo pehle 3.5% par atka rehta tha) se bahar nikalne ka rasta dikhaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Target 5.2% tha aur mila 5.7%, matlab ye plan safal raha!

quiz_payload.question: NABARD (12 July 1982) ki sthapna kis committee ki sifarish par aur kis Five-Year Plan mein hui thi?

options.text: Balwant Rai Mehta Committee — Second Plan

quiz_payload.explanation: NABARD ki sthapna 12 July 1982 ko B. Sivaraman Committee ki sifarish par Sixth Five-Year Plan ke dauran hui thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Seventh Five-Year Plan (1 April 1985 se 31 March 1990 tak chala):
• Model: Pranab Mukherjee Model (Wage-Goods Model se prabhavit).
• Famous Slogan: 'Food, Work and Productivity' (Bhojan, Kaam aur Utpadakta).
• PM Rajiv Gandhi ke netritva mein bana.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Rajiv Gandhi ji ne computer aur nayi technology par zor diya tha na Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Telecommunication aur IT ki shuruaat isi plan se hui.

navigation.button_text: Pehli Baar Private Sector Ko Priority ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 7th Plan ki sabse ahem baat: Bharat ke itihas mein pehli baar Private Sector ko Public Sector (sarkari udyogon) ke mukable zyada budget allocation aur importance di gayi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, pehle to sab kuch sarkar chalati thi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, par sarkar ko laga ki ab private business ko badhava dena zaroori hai taaki factories tezi se badhein.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Seventh Plan ke landmark events:
• 1986: Speed Post service shuru hui.
• 12 April 1988: Share market ko niyamit karne ke liye SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) bana.
• 1 April 1989: NREP aur RLEGP ko milakar gaon ke liye 'Jawahar Rozgar Yojana' (JRY) shuru ki gayi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Speed Post se to chitthi aur parcels jaldi pahunchte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Seventh Plan ke results:
• Target Growth Rate: 5.0%
• Actual Growth Rate: 6.01%!
Ye plan aarthik roop se bohot safal raha aur desh ki economy 6% se upar nikal gayi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Target tha 5% aur mila 6.01%!

quiz_payload.question: 'Food, Work and Productivity' ka nara aur 'Jawahar Rozgar Yojana' (1989) kis Five-Year Plan ka hissa the?
quiz_payload.explanation: Seventh Five-Year Plan (1985-90) ka official slogan 'Food, Work and Productivity' tha aur isi dauran 1989 mein JRY shuru hui.

navigation.button_text: 1990-91: Desh Ka Sabse Bada Aarthik Sankat ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1990 mein desh mein achanak bhayanak sankat aa gaya jise 'Balance of Payments (BoP) Crisis' kehte hain.
Karan:
1. Gulf War (Khadi Yuddh) ke karan petrol ke daam aasman chhoo gaye.
2. Videshon mein rehne wale Bharatiyon ne paisa bhejna kam kar diya.
3. Desh ke paas videshi currency (Forex) sirf 2 hafton ke import ke liye bachi thi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, agar videshi paisa khatam ho jata to kya hota?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Desh petrol, dawai aur zaroori samaan khareedna band kar deta aur desh kangal ghoshit ho jata. Sarkar ko apna 67 tonne sona (gold) Bank of England aur Bank of Switzerland mein girwi (pledge) rakhna pada!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Is bhayanak sankat aur baar-baar sarkar badalne (V.P. Singh aur Chandra Shekhar ki sarkarein) ke karan Eighth Plan 1990 mein shuru nahi ho paya. Isliye 1990 se 1992 tak do Annual Plans (1-1 saal ke plan) chalaye gaye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pehle 1966-69 mein Plan Holiday thi, aur ab 1990-92 mein doosra break aaya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sahi pakde Raju! Is break ke dauran hi Bharat ka itihas badal gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
24 July 1991 ko Pradhan Mantri P.V. Narasimha Rao aur Finance Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh ne 'New Economic Policy' (NEP / LPG Reforms) ka ailaan kiya:
• L = Liberalisation (Udharikaran: License Raj khatam karna)
• P = Privatisation (Nijikaran: Private companies ko aage badhana)
• G = Globalisation (Vaishvikaran: Bharat ke darwaze videshi vyapar ke liye kholna).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: LPG aane ke baad hi desh mein nayi-nayi videshi gaadiyan aur phone aane lage!

quiz_payload.question: 24 July 1991 ko lagu hui New Economic Policy (LPG Reforms) ke samay Bharat ke Prime Minister aur Finance Minister kaun the?

options.text: P.V. Narasimha Rao aur Dr. Manmohan Singh
Atal Bihari Vajpayee aur Yashwant Sinha

quiz_payload.explanation: 1991 ke LPG sudharon ke samay Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao the aur Finance Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh the.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Eighth Five-Year Plan (1 April 1992 se 31 March 1997 tak chala):
• Model: John W. Miller Model (Ise Rao-Manmohan Model bhi kaha jata hai).
• Mukhya Focus: Human Resource Development (Manav Sansadhan — Shiksha, Swasthya, Peene Ka Paani aur Rozgar).
• LPG sudharon ke baad shuru hone wala ye pehla plan tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: LPG ke turant baad 8th plan shuru hua!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: BPSC TRE ka confirmed sawal: 15 August 1995 ko sarkari primary schools mein 'Mid-Day Meal Scheme' (National Programme of Nutritional Support to Primary Education) shuru ki gayi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, is scheme ko shuru karne ka kya maqsad tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Do bade maqsad the:
1. Garib bachhon ko poshan (nutrition) mile taaki wo bimariyon se bachein.
2. Khane ke lalach se bachhe roz school aayein aur school chhodna (dropout) band ho.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Eighth Plan ke do aur landmark events:
• 2 October 1993: Padhe-likhe berozgar yuvaon ke liye 'Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana' (PMRY) shuru hui.
• 1 January 1995: Bharat WTO (World Trade Organization / Vishwa Vyapar Sangathan) ka founding member bana.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: WTO matlab poori duniya mein vyapar ke niyam banane wali sanstha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Eighth Plan ke results bohot hi shandar rahe:
• Target Growth Rate: 5.6%
• Actual Growth Rate: 6.8%!
LPG reforms ka asar dikha aur desh tezi se aage badhne laga.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Target tha 5.6% aur mila 6.8%!

quiz_payload.question: Sarkari schools ke liye prasiddh 'Mid-Day Meal Scheme' (15 August 1995) kis Five-Year Plan ke dauran shuru hui?
quiz_payload.explanation: Mid-Day Meal Scheme 15 August 1995 ko Eighth Five-Year Plan ke dauran shuru ki gayi thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Ninth Five-Year Plan (1 April 1997 se 31 March 2002 tak chala):
• Azadi ke 50 saal poore hone par launch kiya gaya.
• Official Theme: 'Growth with Social Justice and Equity' (Samajik Nyay aur Samanta Ke Saath Vikas).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, samajik nyay ka matlab kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Matlab vikas ka fayda sirf ameer logon ko na mile, balki SC, ST, OBC, mahilaon aur garibon tak barabar pahuche.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
9th Plan ke samne 3 badi rukawatein aayin:
1. 1997: East Asian Financial Crisis (Asia ke deshon mein aarthik mandi).
2. May 1998: Pokhran-2 Parmanu Parikshan ke baad America ne Bharat par aarthik pratibandh (Sanctions) laga diye.
3. 1999: Kargil Yuddh ka achanak kharcha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isliye is plan ki growth thodi dheemi ho gayi hogi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
25 December 2000 ko PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee ke janamdin par 'Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana' (PMGSY) shuru hui.
• Target: Desh ke har gaon ko barahmaasi pakki sadak (all-weather road) se jodna.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hamare gaon mein jo pakki sadak ka board laga hai, uspar PMGSY hi likha hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
9th Plan ke do aur landmark programmes:
• December 2000: 'Antyodaya Anna Yojana' (AAY) shuru hui — sabse gareeb parivaron ko ₹2/kg gehun aur ₹3/kg chawal (35 kg anaj).
• 2001: 'Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan' (SSA) shuru hua — 'Sab Padhein, Sab Badhein' (School Chalein Hum).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pencil par do bachhe baithe wala photo Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan ka hi hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Ninth Plan ke results:
• Target Growth Rate: 6.5%
• Actual Growth Rate: 5.4% (Target miss ho gaya).
Karan: Kargil war, American sanctions aur international mandi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Target tha 6.5% par mila 5.4%.

quiz_payload.question: 'Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana' (PMGSY - 25 Dec 2000) aur 'Antyodaya Anna Yojana' kis Five-Year Plan mein shuru hui?
quiz_payload.explanation: PMGSY aur Antyodaya Anna Yojana dono saal 2000 mein Ninth Five-Year Plan ke dauran launch hui thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tenth Five-Year Plan (1 April 2002 se 31 March 2007 tak chala):
• Target: 8.0% GDP growth
• Mukhya Goals:
1. Agle 10 saal mein Per Capita Income (Prati Vyakti Aay) double karna.
2. Gareebi anupaat (Poverty ratio) ko 5% kam karna.
3. Har rajya ke liye alag-alag vikas target tay karna.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, isme garibon ke rozgar ke liye kya bada kanoon bana?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tenth Plan ke dauran September 2005 mein Parliament ne NREGA Act pass kiya (2 Feb 2006 se Andhra Pradesh ke Anantapur se lagu hua, baad mein naam badal kar MGNREGA hua).
• Kanooni Guarantee: Gaon ke har parivar ko saal mein 100 din ke aakushal majdoori rozgar ki guarantee.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Job Card banwakar gaon mein talab khodne ka kaam milta hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tenth Plan ke 2 aur bohot bade programmes:
1. Bharat Nirman (2005): Gaon ke 6 kshetron ka vikas — Sinchai, Sadak, Awas (Ghar), Paani, Bijli aur Telephone.
2. NRHM (National Rural Health Mission - 2005): Gaon mein ASHA bahu aur behtar swasthya suvidha.

messages.speaker: raju

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tenth Plan ke results bohot mazboot rahe:
• Target Growth Rate: 8.0%
• Actual Growth Rate: 7.6%!
Desh ki economy bohot tez raftaar se aage badhi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Target tha 8.0% aur mila 7.6%!

quiz_payload.question: 100 din ke rozgar ki guarantee dene wala 'NREGA/MGNREGA Kanoon' (2005) aur 'Bharat Nirman' kis Five-Year Plan mein shuru hue?
quiz_payload.explanation: MGNREGA Act 2005 aur Bharat Nirman Programme dono Tenth Five-Year Plan ke dauran launch kiye gaye the.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Eleventh Five-Year Plan (1 April 2007 se 31 March 2012 tak chala):
• Draft Prepared By: Dr. C. Rangarajan
• Official Theme: 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth' (Tez aur Adhik Samaveshi Vikas Ki Ore).
BPSC ka ye super-repeat question hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, 'Inclusive Growth' (Samaveshi Vikas) ka kya matlab hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Matlab vikas ki gaadi mein desh ka koi bhi nagrik peechhe na chhoote — kisan, majdoor, mahilaayein, sabhi ko barabar mauka mile.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
11th Plan ke dauran 2009 mein Parliament ne RTE Act (Right to Education / Shiksha Ka Adhikar Kanoon) pass kiya, jo 1 April 2010 se poore desh mein lagu hua.
• Samvidhan ka Article 21A: 6 se 14 saal ke sabhi bachhon ko muft aur anivarya padhai ka kanooni adhikar mila.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, matlab har bachhe ko school jana zaroori aur muft ho gaya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
11th Plan ke results:
• Target Growth Rate: 9.0%
• Actual Growth Rate: 8.0%!
2008 mein poori duniya mein bhayanak aarthik mandi (Global Recession) aayi thi, fir bhi Bharat ne 8.0% growth hasil ki, jo saare 12 plans mein sabse tej thi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sabhi 12 plans mein sabse zyada growth 11th plan mein hi mili thi!

quiz_payload.question: 11th Five-Year Plan (2007-12) ki official theme kya thi aur isne kitni average GDP growth hasil ki?

options.text: Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth — 8.0%

quiz_payload.explanation: 11th Plan ki theme 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth' thi aur isne 8.0% ki sabse tez growth darj ki thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Twelfth Five-Year Plan (1 April 2012 se 31 March 2017 tak chala):
• Ye Bharat ki LAST (aakhiri) Five-Year Plan thi!
• Official Theme: 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth' (Yahan 'Sustainable' yani Paryavaran ke sath satat vikas shabd joda gaya).
• Revised Target: 8.0%.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 11th mein sirf Inclusive tha, 12th mein Sustainable bhi jud gaya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 12th Plan chal hi raha tha ki May 2014 mein nayi sarkar aayi. 15 August 2014 ko Lal Qile ki pracheer se PM Narendra Modi ne ailaan kiya ki 64 saal purane Planning Commission ko khatam kiya jayega.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, fir Planning Commission ki jagah kya bana?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1 January 2015 ko 'NITI Aayog' bana! 12th Plan ko 31 March 2017 tak formally chalne diya gaya, lekin iske baad 13th Plan kabhi nahi aayi.

quiz_payload.question: Bharat ki 12th (Aakhiri) Five-Year Plan (2012-17) ki official theme kya thi?

options.text: Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth
Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth
Growth with Social Justice and Equity

quiz_payload.explanation: 12th Plan ki theme 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth' thi. 11th Plan mein 'Sustainable' shabd nahi tha.

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Indian Five-Year Plans:
1. 'Garibi Hatao' was the primary objective of the Fifth Five-Year Plan.
2. NABARD was established during the Seventh Five-Year Plan.
3. The Eleventh Five-Year Plan recorded the highest average GDP growth rate among all plans.

quiz_payload.explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is WRONG because NABARD was established on 12 July 1982 during the Sixth Five-Year Plan, not the Seventh.

Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

quiz_payload.explanation: Both statements are TRUE and R correctly explains A. 1990-91 ke BoP sankat ke karan hi 8th plan 2 saal late hua.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, 1 January 2015 ko sarkar ne purane Planning Commission ki jagah ek naya sansthan banaya — NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, iska poora naam English mein bada hai. NITI ka matlab kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NITI ka full form hai 'National Institution for Transforming India'. Ye bhi purane commission ki tarah Cabinet ke normal aadesh (Executive Resolution) se bana. Matlab ye bhi Extra-Constitutional aur Non-Statutory body hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, paper mein likha rehta hai ki NITI Aayog sarkar ka 'Think Tank' hai. Iska kya matlab hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Think Tank ka matlab hota hai 'Dimag Lagane Wali Team'! Jaise ghar mein koi bada kaam karne se pehle hum baith kar salah lete hain, waise hi NITI Aayog sarkar ko acche-acche ideas aur salah (advice) deta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! To ye sarkar ko sirf salah deta hai, khud hukum nahi chalata!

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) ka gathan kab hua tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog 1 January 2015 ko Cabinet resolution ke dwara sthapit kiya gaya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ka kaam 7 mukhya pillars par tika hai:
1. Pro-People (Janta ke hit mein)
2. Pro-Active (Pehle se taiyar rehna)
3. Participation (Janta ki bhagidari)
4. Empowering (Sabko majboot karna, khas kar mahilaon ko)
5. Inclusion of All (SC, ST, garib sabko shamil karna)
6. Equality (Sabko barabar mauka)
7. Transparency (Kamo mein pardarshita).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab sabhi logon ko sath lekar chalne ka niyam hai!

navigation.button_text: NITI Aayog Ki Team Kaun Hai? ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ki team ka hisab dekho:
• Chairperson: Desh ke Prime Minister (Ex-officio)
• Vice-Chairperson: PM dwara appoint kiya jata hai (Cabinet Minister ka darja milta hai). Pehle the Arvind Panagariya.
• CEO (Chief Executive Officer): Ek senior IAS officer. Pehli CEO thi Sindhushree Khullar.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, isme pehle Vice-Chairperson Arvind Panagariya the!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NITI Aayog ki sabse badi taqat hai iski 'Governing Council'. Isme Bharat ke SABHI rajyon ke Chief Ministers aur sabhi Union Territories ke Lieutenant Governors shamil hote hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Bihar ke Mukhyamantri bhi iske direct member hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Purane Planning Commission mein CMs member nahi the, par NITI Aayog mein sabhi CMs barabar ke sadasya hain. Isko bolte hain 'Cooperative Federalism' (Mil-jul kar kaam karna)!

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ki 'Governing Council' mein nimnlikhit mein se kaun shamil hote hain?

options.text: Sabhi Rajyon ke Mukhyamantri (CMs) aur UTs ke Lt. Governors

quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog ki Governing Council mein Prime Minister ke sath sabhi rajyon ke Chief Ministers aur UTs ke Lt. Governors member hote hain.

navigation.button_text: Paise Ka Faisla Kaun Karta Hai? ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ek bohot bada antar yaad rakhna: Purana Planning Commission rajyon ko PAISA BAANTTA tha (fund allocate karta tha).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya NITI Aayog bhi rajyon ko paisa deta hai Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi! NITI Aayog ke paas paisa baantne ka koi adhikar nahi hai. NITI Aayog sirf salah (advice) deta hai. Rajyon ko paisa dene ka kaam ab Finance Ministry (Vitta Mantralaya) karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! Planning Commission ke paas paise ki tijori thi, NITI Aayog ke paas sirf salah hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ne 5-Year Plan band karke 3 naye document banaye:
1. 15-Year Vision Document (15 saal ka lamba sapna)
2. 7-Year Strategy Document (7 saal ki ranniti)
3. 3-Year Action Agenda (Agle 3 saal mein kya kaam karna hai).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pehle 5 saal tha, ab 15, 7 aur 3 saal ka hisab hai!

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ke naye framework mein 'Action Agenda' kitne varsho ke liye banaya jata hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog ne 15-Year Vision, 7-Year Strategy aur 3-Year Action Agenda ka model apnaya hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NITI Aayog ne bachhon mein science aur aavishkar ko badhane ke liye chalaya hai 'Atal Innovation Mission' (AIM). Iske tehat schools mein 'Atal Tinkering Labs' (ATL) lagai jaati hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ATL lab mein bachhe kya karte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Class 6th se 12th ke bachhe wahan robot banana, 3D printing aur electronic circuit banana seekhte hain taaki wo aage chalkar scientist aur naye aavishkarak banein.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ BPSC Special Fact: January 2018 mein NITI Aayog ne desh ke 112 pichhde zilon ke vikas ke liye 'Aspirational Districts Programme' (Aakankshi Zila Karyakram) shuru kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya isme hamare Bihar ke bhi zile hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Bihar ke total 13 Zile isme shamil hain (jaise Katihar, Begusarai, Sheikhpura, Gaya, Banka, Nawada aadi). Ye number '13' BPSC mein seedhe pucha jata hai!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ NITI Aayog ke 'Aspirational Districts Programme' (ADP) mein Bihar ke kul kitne zile shamil hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog ke Aspirational Districts Programme mein Bihar ke 13 pichhde zilon ko shamil kiya gaya hai.

navigation.button_text: SDG India Index: Rajyon Ka Report Card ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NITI Aayog har saal rajyon ka ek Report Card nikalta hai jise 'SDG India Index' kehte hain. Isme dekha jata hai ki kaunsa rajya safai, peene ke paani, school aur bijli mein aage nikal raha hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, isme rajyon ko ranking milti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Kerala hamesha top par rehta hai. Is ranking se sabhi rajyon mein accha kaam karne ki hod (Competitive Federalism) lagti hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ek 'National Multidimensional Poverty Index' (MPI) nikalta hai. Isme sirf jeb ka paisa nahi dekha jata, balki 3 baatein dekhi jaati hain:
1. Swasthya (Health — Poshan aur bache ka swasthya)
2. Shiksha (Education — School attendance)
3. Rehan-Sehan (Bijli, Paani, Gas Cylinder, Shauchalay aur Bank Khata).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab basic suvidhaon se garibi naapi jaati hai!

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ke Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) mein garibi naapne ke 3 mukhya aadhar kaun se hain?

options.text: Swasthya (Health), Shiksha (Education) aur Rehan-Sehan (Standard of Living)
Sirf Mobile aur TV ki sankhya

quiz_payload.explanation: MPI mein Swasthya, Shiksha aur Rehan-Sehan ke kul 12 sanketakon (indicators) par garibi naapi jaati hai.

summary_payload.title: ⚖️ Planning Commission vs NITI Aayog: Ek Nazar Mein

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission aur NITI Aayog ke sandarbh mein kaun sa kathan SAHI hai?

options.text: Planning Commission funds allocate karta tha, jabki NITI Aayog sirf advisory think-tank hai
NITI Aayog ke paas 5-Year Plan banane ka adhikar hai
Planning Commission mein sabhi Mukhyamantri permanent sadasya the

quiz_payload.explanation: Planning Commission rajyon ko fund baantta tha, par NITI Aayog ke paas fund baantne ka koi adhikar nahi hai; ye sirf advisory sanstha hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ Ab aate hain Bihar par! Jaise desh ke liye Planning Commission/NITI Aayog tha, waise hi Bihar ke liye 'Bihar State Planning Board' (Bihar Rajya Yojna Parishad) hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Bihar State Planning Board ke Head kaun hote hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jaise desh mein Prime Minister Chairman hote the, waise hi Bihar mein Bihar ke Chief Minister (Mukhyamantri) iske Chairman hote hain!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar Rajya Yojna Parishad (State Planning Board) ke Adhyaksh (Chairman) kaun hote hain?

options.text: Patna High Court ke Chief Justice

quiz_payload.explanation: Bihar State Planning Board ke ex-officio Chairman Bihar ke Chief Minister hote hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: BPSC TRE aur BPSC ka favourite Article: Samvidhan ke Article 243ZD ke tehat har zile mein ek 'District Planning Committee' (DPC / Zila Yojna Samiti) banti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, DPC ka kaam kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Gaon ki Panchayaton aur Shahar ki Nagarpalikao ke alag-alag plans ko milakar pure zile ka ek comprehensive vikas plan taiyar karna.

quiz_payload.question: Bhartiya Samvidhan ke kis anuchhed (Article) ke antargat har zile mein 'District Planning Committee' (DPC) ka pravdhan hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: 74th Constitutional Amendment ke dwara Article 243ZD ke tehat District Planning Committee (DPC) ka pravdhan kiya gaya hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Samvidhan ke Article 243-I (Panchayaton ke liye) aur Article 243-Y (Nagarpalikaon ke liye) ke tehat Bihar ke Governor har 5 saal mein 'State Finance Commission' (Rajya Vitta Aayog) banate hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ye commission kya karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye tay karta hai ki Bihar sarkar ke tax ke paise mein se kitna hissa gaon ki Panchayaton aur shehar ki Nagarpalikaon ko road, naali aur light ke liye milna chahiye.

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar Rajya Vitta Aayog (State Finance Commission) ka gathan Governor dwara kis anuchhed ke tehat kiya jata hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 243-I (Panchayato ke liye) aur Article 243-Y (Nagarpalikao ke liye) ke tehat har 5 saal mein Governor dwara State Finance Commission banaya jata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ BPSC ka sabse favorite topic: 2015 mein Bihar sarkar (CM Nitish Kumar) ne vikas ke 7 pakke sankalp liye jise 'Saat Nischay-1' kaha gaya (2015–2020).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya hume saare 7 nischay ke naam yaad karne honge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! BPSC mein seedhe pucha jata hai ki kaunsa nischay iska hissa tha ya nahi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Saat Nischay-1 (2015–2020) ke 7 sankalp:
1. Aarthik Hal, Yuvaon ko Bal (Student Credit Card, Swayam Sahayata Bhatta, Kushal Yuva Programme)
2. Aarakshit Rozgar, Mahilaon ka Adhikar (Sarkari naukriyon mein mahilaon ko 35% reservation)
3. Har Ghar Bijli Lagataar
4. Har Ghar Nal ka Jal
5. Ghar Tak Pakki Gali-Naliyan
6. Shauchalay Nirman, Ghar ka Samman
7. Awsar Badhe, Aage Padhe.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, humne padha ki Planning Commission garibi hatane ke liye plan banata tha. Par socho, sarkar ko kaise pata chalta hai ki kaun garib hai aur kaun nahi?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, jiske paas khana khane aur kapda pehanne ka paisa nahi hota, wahi garib hota hoga!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Iske liye sarkar ek lakshman-rekha banati hai jise 'Poverty Line' (Garibi Rekha) kehte hain. Is lakshman-rekha ko tay karne ke liye Planning Commission ne alag-alag samay par 4 badi committees banayin.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1979 mein aayi Y.K. Alagh Committee. Isne sabse pehle garibi ko pet bharne ki taqat (Calorie) se naapa:
• Gaon (Rural): 2400 Calorie per person per day (kyunki gaon mein mehnat zyada hoti hai)
• Shahar (Urban): 2100 Calorie per person per day.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Calorie matlab jo khane se taqat milti hai na Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Agar kisi ko roz itna khana na mile, to wo garibi rekha ke neeche mana gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1993 mein aayi D.T. Lakdawala Committee. Isne Calorie wala niyam barkarar rakha, par kaha ki har rajya mein mehngai alag-alag hoti hai.
• Gaon mein mehangai naapne ke liye: CPI-AL (Consumer Price Index for Agricultural Labourers)
• Shahar ke liye: CPI-IW (Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers) use kiya gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Bihar ki mehangai aur Delhi ki mehangai ka alag hisab hua!

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission ke niyam ke anusaar, gramin (rural) kshetron mein nirdhanta rekha ke liye prati vyakti kitni calorie nirdharit ki gayi thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Y.K. Alagh aur Lakdawala Committee ke anusaar gaon ke liye 2400 Calorie aur shahar ke liye 2100 Calorie per day tay thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ BPSC ka sabse favorite topic: Suresh Tendulkar Committee (2009). Isne Calorie ka formula hata diya aur kaha ki garibi sirf khane se nahi, balki Padhai, Dawai aur Kapde ke kharche se bhi naapi jayegi.
• Consumption Basket (Kharch): Uniform Recall Period (URP) ki jagah Mixed Reference Period (MRP) apnaaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Tendulkar sir ne khane ke sath dawai aur school ke kharche ko bhi joda!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tendulkar Committee (2011-12 data) ke cut-off rat lo:
• Gaon (Rural): ₹816 per month (lagbhag ₹27.20 per day)
• Shahar (Urban): ₹1000 per month (lagbhag ₹33.33 per day)
• Desh mein kul garibi: 21.9%
• ⭐ Bihar mein garibi: Lagbhag 33.74% log garib the!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, gaon mein 27 rupaye roz aur shahar mein 33 rupaye roz!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Suresh Tendulkar Committee (2011-12) ke anusaar, Bharat mein kul kitne pratishat aabadi garibi rekha ke neeche (BPL) thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Tendulkar Committee (2011-12) ke anusaar Bharat mein kul garibi 21.9% darj ki gayi thi (Bihar mein lagbhag 33.74%).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tendulkar ke 27-33 rupaye par bawaal hua to 2014 mein bani Dr. C. Rangarajan Committee. Isne kharch ki limit badhai:
• Gaon: ₹972 per month (lagbhag ₹32 per day)
• Shahar: ₹1407 per month (lagbhag ₹47 per day)
• Desh mein garibi: 29.5%
• ⭐ Bihar mein garibi: 41.4% aayi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Rangarajan sir ne limit badha kar 32 aur 47 rupaye kar di thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ BPSC 70th/71st Direct Question: NITI Aayog ke National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) report ke anusaar:
• NFHS-4 (2015-16) mein Bihar mein 51.89% log multidimensionally garib the.
• NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein ye ghatkar **33.76%** ho gaya!
Matlab lagbhag 18.13% log (2 crore 25 lakh se zyada log) garibi se bahar nikle!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bihar mein garibi 51.89% se ghatkar 33.76% par aa gayi!

navigation.button_text: ⭐ Bihar Ke Kaun Se Zile Aage/Peechhe? ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
MPI Report ke anusaar Bihar ke zilon ki sthiti:
• Sabse Garib Zila: **Araria** (Lagbhag 52% multidimensional garibi) aur Kishanganj.
• Sabse Kam Garib Zila: **Patna** (Lagbhag 16.6% garibi) aur Siwan.
• Sabse Tez Sudhar Karne Wala Zila: **East Champaran** (Purvi Champaran)!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sabse kam garibi Patna mein aur sabse zyada Araria mein!

navigation.button_text: Tax Devolution: Kendra Se Paisa Kaise Milta Hai? ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, socho Kendra sarkar jo income tax aur GST collect karti hai, kya wo saara paisa khud rakh leti hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nahi Sir, rajyon ko bhi sadak aur school banane ke liye hissa deti hogi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! Samvidhan ke Article 280 ke tehat 'Finance Commission' (Vitta Aayog) tay karta hai ki Kendra ke tax mein se kitna pratishat rajyon ko baanta jayega. Is batware ko 'Tax Devolution' kehte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ BPSC ka pakka sawaal: 15th Finance Commission (Chairman: N.K. Singh — jo khud Bihar cadre ke IAS the):
• Rajyon ka kul hissa: 41% (J&K ke UT banne ke baad 1% kam kiya gaya).
• Desh ke kul 41% batware mein se **Bihar ka hissa: 10.058%** tay hua!
• UP ke baad Bihar poore desh mein doosra sabse bada hissedar hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bihar ka hissa 10.058% hai aur N.K. Singh Chairman the!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
15th Finance Commission ne paisa baantne ke liye ye criteria banaya:
1. Income Distance (45%) — Jo rajya jitna garib, usko utna zyada paisa
2. 2011 Population (15%)
3. Area/Kshetraphal (15%)
4. Forest & Ecology (10%)
5. Demographic Performance (12.5%) — Jisne jansankhya control ki
6. Tax Effort (2.5%).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Income Distance ka weightage 45% hai, isliye Bihar ko accha share mila!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ 15th Finance Commission (N.K. Singh ki adhyakshta) ke anusaar, kendriya karon ke vibhajan mein Bihar ka hissa kitna pratishat nirdharit kiya gaya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: 15th Finance Commission mein Bihar ka horizontal tax share 10.058% tay kiya gaya hai (UP ke baad doosra sabse bada).

navigation.button_text: Special Status Ab Kanoonan Kyun Nahi Mil Sakta? ➔

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Bihar bar-bar Special Category Status (Vishesh Rajya Darja) maangta hai, par Kendra sarkar kanooni roop se ise kyun mana karti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
BPSC Mains ka technical point suno:
1. Special Status 'Planning Commission' (Gadgil Formula) deta tha. Jab 2014 mein Planning Commission hi khatam ho gaya, to wo kanooni pravdhan bhi samapt ho gaya.
2. 14th Finance Commission (Y.V. Reddy) ne kaha ki rajyon ko 32% se badha kar 42% untied tax de diya gaya hai, isliye ab kisi naye rajya ko Special Status nahi diya ja sakta (sirf 11 Pahadi/Northeast rajyon ko chhodkar).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab naye niyam ke hisab se kisi naye rajya ko Special Status dene ka kanooni rasta band hai!

navigation.button_text: Special Status Ka Vikalp: Special Package ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Special Status na milne ke karan Kendra sarkar ab Bihar ko 'Special Economic Package', extra Centrally Sponsored Scheme funds, aur expressways (jaise Patna-Purnea, Amas-Darbhanga Expressway) ke zariye aarthik sahayata deti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! To status ki jagah alag se projects aur package milte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
2017 ke baad Planning Commission khatam hone par Bihar budget mein bada badlav hua:
• Pehle: 'Plan vs Non-Plan Expenditure' hota tha.
• Ab: 'Scheme Expenditure' (Yojnayein) aur 'Establishment & Committed Expenditure' (Vetan, Pension, Byaj) mein hisab hota hai.
• Saath hi Capital Outlay (Poonjigat Kharch — Sadak, Pul, Hospital banane par) badhaya gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Plan/Non-plan khatam karke Scheme aur Establishment kharch banaya gaya!

navigation.button_text: BPSC Mains: Command vs Market Enabler ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
BPSC Mains GS Paper-2 ke liye ek behtareen analytical concept samjho:
• Planning Commission Era (1950–2014): 'Command Economy' tha — sarkar sab tay karti thi (License Raj aur Top-Down control).
• NITI Aayog Era (2015 se): 'Market Enabler & Catalyst' hai — sarkar business aur innovation ko aage badhati hai, private sector aur rajyon ko sath lekar chalti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pehle sarkar akele chalati thi, ab sabko sath lekar chalne ka platform hai!

revision_points.point: 1950 mein command model ki zaroorat thi (Resource scarcity), 2015 mein federal model ki zaroorat bani.
Centralised allocation ➔ Cooperative & Competitive Federalism (Governing Council).
Special Category Status ki maang vs 15th FC Devolution (10.058%) + Saat Nischay execution.
NITI Aayog ko financial dispute resolution body banana aur bottom-up district planning (Art 243ZD) ko activate karna.

navigation.button_text: Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS) Ka Naya Niyam ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ne Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS) ko 3 hisson mein baanta (Shivraj Singh Chouhan sub-committee):
1. Core of the Core (Jaise MGNREGA, NSAP — Kendra-Rajya hissa badal nahi sakta)
2. Core Schemes (Jaise Samagra Shiksha, PMAY, Swachh Bharat — 60:40 share)
3. Optional Schemes (Rajya chahe to le ya na le).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isse rajyon ko apni marzi ki schemes chunne ki aazadi mili!

Consider the following statements:
1. The 11th Five-Year Plan achieved an average GDP growth rate of 8.0%.
2. In the 15th Finance Commission devolution formula, Income Distance carries a weight of 45%.
3. The concept of Rolling Plan was formulated by Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis.
4. Bihar State Finance Commission is constituted under Article 243-I.

How many of the above statements are CORRECT?
quiz_payload.explanation: Statements 1, 2, and 4 are CORRECT. Statement 3 is WRONG because the Rolling Plan was formulated based on Gunnar Myrdal's concept and designed by D.T. Lakdawala, not Mahalanobis.

Assertion (A): After the 14th and 15th Finance Commissions, no new state can legally be granted Special Category Status (SCS).

Reason (R): Special Category Status was granted by the erstwhile Planning Commission through the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, which ceased to exist after 2014.

Choose the correct option:

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

quiz_payload.explanation: Both statements are TRUE and R explains A perfectly. Planning Commission khatam hone ke sath Gadgil formula aur naye rajyon ko SCS dene ka kanooni pravdhan samapt ho gaya.
